summary.text: Cindy Nava is a Democrat who has served in the New Mexico Senate since 2025, representing District 9 in Bernalillo and Sandoval counties, and is the Senate Majority Whip.
Nava sits on the Senate Education Committee and the Senate Health and Public Affairs Committee.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's member page lists Nava's occupation as consultant and a district office in Bernalillo.
Between sessions, Nava is co-chair of the Federal Funding Stabilization and Affordability Subcommittee and a member of the Courts, Corrections and Justice Committee.
